F1.value: TellorMaster proxy 0x88df verified (Blockscout, 2023-11-18); implementation Tellor360 0xd3b9...ded7 verified (2024-02-25)

F2.value: Mint paths: mintToOracle/mintToTeam at a fixed 146.94 TRB/day each (constants in code), and migrate() mints the caller's balance on the original 2019 TRB contract 0x0ba45...a2e5 once per address (old totalSupply 1,784,082; unmigrated remainder not measured). No owner mint. Holds only as long as the implementation isn't swapped (F4)
F2.source: Tellor360.sol + BaseToken.sol source; old contract totalSupply eth_call

F3.value: Not an EOA, but no timelock: _OWNER = 0x39e4 MultiSigWalletWithDailyLimit, 2-of-3 (owners 0x28dc...f090, 0x0d7e...eba4, 0xa579...2616, all EOAs), dailyLimit 0. It can instantly: changeOwner; teamTransferDisputedStake (moves the stake balance of any legacy TellorX staker with status 3 to any address, which touches balances); transferOutOfContract; and, via Parachute, migrateFor (moves Parachute's 46,665 TRB) and killContract. It also gains _DEITY (instant implementation upgrade) through Parachute rescues. None of this sits behind a >=48h timelock
F3.source: TellorMaster, BaseToken, Parachute verified source; getAddressVars(_OWNER/_DEITY), getOwners(), required() eth_call (publicnode)

F4.value: Upgradeable: TellorMaster.changeTellorContract(addr) by _DEITY swaps the implementation instantly, with no delay. _DEITY = Parachute 0x83eb...6084 (contract). Anyone can trigger rescueBrokenDataReporting (oracle timestamp stale >7 days) or rescueFailedUpdate, which hand _DEITY to the 2-of-3 team multisig. The upgrade admin is therefore conditionally a no-timelock multisig, which does not meet F3. GoPlus is_proxy=1; honeypot.is isProxy true
F4.source: TellorMaster/Parachute source; getAddressVars(_DEITY) eth_call; TokenBridgeV2.getTimeOfLastNewValue = 2026-11-16 13:17 UTC (rescue not currently armed)

F5.value: No blacklist, pause or freeze in BaseToken/Tellor360. The only transfer restriction is allowedToTrade, which locks the stake amount of legacy disputed stakers. GoPlus returned no is_blacklisted/transfer_pausable fields (proxy); judged from source

F6.value: No taxes, max-tx limits or trading toggles in source. GoPlus buy_tax 0, sell_tax 0, transfer_tax 0 (slippage_modifiable not returned). honeypot.is buy/sell/transfer tax 0

F7.value: honeypot.is isHoneypot false, risk low, 79/79 holder sells simulated OK. GoPlus cannot_buy 0, is_honeypot/cannot_sell_all not returned (proxy)

F8.value: Uniswap V4 TRB pool (0xc6df...656b, fee 1%) holds ~$12.2k of ~$13.5k on-chain liquidity (~91%). Its LP position (NFT 197380) is held by EOA 0x6b5f...6ff7 (eth_getCode empty), is_locked 0. Small pool, but the test as written fails

F9.value: Tellor360 is custom code, not standard OZ ERC-20. No public audit of Tellor360/TellorMaster located in this pass (web search returned only a Cyberscope listing page, not opened)
